Observed destructive-time-course design. The
k1-independent-acceptance-shared_baseline_missing_cells experiment uses the layer1 layer to
assess the declared condition target contrasts treated with control. Points show independent
biological observations; Labels give biological sample counts per design cell; Crosses mark
unobserved condition-by-time cells. The analysis unit is independent biological observation;
the design is independent_time_course; the estimand is condition-by-time interaction on the
rank scale; time is recorded as observed_time. Facet labels report stored interaction intervals
and resampling recurrence. Raw p-values are retained; q-values use Holm correction across
declared components within each metadata field and evidence variant. 3 unobserved
condition-by-time cells are marked with crosses. The declared condition-by-time interaction is
not estimable. No acceptance threshold is applied. No unique biological coordinate is
identified.
